_note: Supersedes the criteria seeded Aug 31, 2026. IEI validation and analysis now complete in Spring rather than Fall, so Fall weight shifts toward the literature review and the dashboard itself, and Spring separates the IEI construction pipeline from the health outcome pipeline. Component ids are deliberately unchanged wherever a component is the same work renamed or reweighted, so completed tasks keep their links.

fall_2026.description: Development of the IEI construction pipeline, the supporting literature base, and the methods manuscript. Validation and outcome analysis move to Spring.

components.name: IEI Annotated Bibliography
components.description: Minimum 25 sources annotated with relevance to the Integrated Exposure Index: time-weighted exposure models, indoor/outdoor pollutant integration, spatial interpolation methods. Due by Sep 21st, 2026.

components.name: IEI Literature Review
components.description: Narrative review of environmental exposure science literature supporting the IEI construct: time-activity patterns, multi-pollutant indices, exposure measurement in existing cohorts. Draft #1 due by Oct 26th, 2026. Final draft due by Nov 2nd, 2026.

components.name: IEI Construction Pipeline & GitHub Repository
components.description: Functional, documented IEI construction pipeline: outdoor data integration (TCEQ/EPA), indoor survey scoring, time-weighting algorithm, composite scoring. Continuous with no final due date; draft due for review by Oct 21, 2026.

components.name: IEI Manuscript Draft
components.description: Initial draft of specific sections of the IEI methods paper: Introduction and Planned Methods. Journal-formatted draft with a clear journal target and list of backup journals. Due by Nov 9th, 2026.

components.name: Meeting Attendance & Participation
components.description: Consistent attendance per cadence schedule at the start of Fall semester; prepared agendas; responsiveness to sponsor feedback; documented action items. Effective updates to other committee members.

components.name: Fall Progress Presentation
components.description: Presentation to thesis committee summarizing IEI development, preliminary methods, and spring semester plan. Delivered 1-2 weeks before fall final exams begin (Dec 7, 2026).

components.name: IEI Command Center Creation & Maintenance
components.description: GitHub/Vercel app used to document task items and progress of the thesis across the fall semester. Creation, sharing with committee, and consistent maintenance and updates. Continuous; shared with committee by Oct 1st, 2026.

spring_2027.description: Finalization of the IEI construction and validation pipeline, the health outcome analysis against existing BREATHE-CC participants, the methods manuscript, the research poster, the extended thesis, and the public defense.

components.name: Finalized IEI Construction/Calculation Pipeline
components.description: Functional, documented IEI construction pipeline: outdoor data integration (TCEQ/EPA), indoor survey scoring, time-weighting algorithm, composite scoring. In addition to Fall products, includes detailed calculations, validation methods, and statistical analyses developed in the Spring. Demonstrated with existing and simulated data. Submitted by March 15th, 2027.

components.name: IEI Manuscript Finalization
components.description: Journal-ready IEI methods manuscript, formatted per target journal guidelines. Incorporates all committee feedback and analysis results. Submitted as final version by April 1st, 2027 to the committee and — if all authors agree it is not necessary to wait for final cohort data — to the target journal for peer review.

components.name: Health Outcome Analysis Pipeline
components.description: Code and outputs for IEI-asthma outcome analysis: bivariate and adjusted regression models (Poisson/negative binomial for exacerbations, linear mixed models for C-ACT, GBTM for wheezing phenotypes). Sensitivity checks and subgroup analyses. Reproducible, documented pipeline designed for rerunning on the finalized BREATHE-CC cohort. Submitted by April 12th, 2027.

components.name: Research Poster
components.description: Conference-style research poster summarizing IEI development, validation, and preliminary health outcome findings based on available BREATHE-CC data. Presented at the Rollins Honors Summit in April 2027.

components.name: Meeting Attendance & Participation
components.description: Continued adherence to meeting cadence; proactive communication; timely incorporation of feedback.

components.name: Thesis Defense & Final Submission
components.description: Public oral defense including 25-30 min presentation and committee Q&A by the week before spring final exams begin (at the latest). Post-defense revisions and final submission to the Rollins Honors Program by May 1st, 2027.

components.name: Final Thesis Draft
components.description: Full extended version of the thesis documenting timeline, full literature review, extended methods documentation, and preliminary outcome analysis, to be submitted to the Rollins Undergraduate Journal/Library by May 1st, 2027.
